title: G25: adversarial claim-evidence tests without financial write methods
public_pr_body:
Nine independent tests pass on committed reviewer code 1fb3eddd: seven hostile/ambiguous/future/question/refund/cross-company message cases call only the company-bound evidence RPC, and both claim-resolution outcomes call only resolve_payment_claim. Service doubles expose no financial table writes and each financial-control argument is separately forbidden. No real email, payment or customer record used.

Reviewed intake and 138 claim/resolution SQL: claim evidence and its resolution are separate from Record payment. Existing baseline inbound/chase tests also passed. Full actual-DB invoice/payment/balance invariance remains NOT EXECUTED because the identified full stack is blocked by registry policy. Unit evidence is not promoted to end-to-end financial proof. All original combined logs (including unrelated G27 failures), hashes/time/exit/environment and exact committed rerun retained.

Handover: tests/reviews/b5-g25/B5-G25-REVIEW.md.

- [x] Separate owned reviewer branch; original failures retained; source/lint/type/whitespace checks scoped in report. Raw logs kept byte-for-byte, including original whitespace.
- [ ] Independent owner assessment, actual final-candidate runtime evidence and authorised acceptance remain open.

Explicit Rhys overnight allocation. New b5 test/tool/review files only; no Claude-owned source/test edits, #359 branch modification, ISO pack work, Ready label, main merge, production migrations/wipe/import/counter change, deployment, live AI/automated email or message to John. PRs targeting #359’s branch are review follow-ups only; no merge is requested. Production actions remain subject to Rhys’s separate approval.
